kind_of_thing.quote: Lovebird is the common name for the genus Agapornis, a small group of parrots in the Old World parrot family Psittaculidae.

kind_of_animal.quote: A lovebird (Agapornis) is a type of parrot.

extinct.quote: Of the nine extant species in the genus, all are native to the African continent, with the grey-headed lovebird being native to the African island of Madagascar.
